items.headline: Ohio State replaces BYU at No. 2 as Top 25 jumbled again by top-10 losses
items.description: No. 1 Miami was the only team to hold its spot in The Associated Press Top 25 on Sunday as idle Ohio State moved up to No. 2 and the poll went through another major reordering in the wake of BYU's loss at UCF and subsequent six-spot fall to No. 8.

items.headline: Steve Sarkisian lauds 'edgy' Arch Manning after Texas holds off Ole Miss
items.description: No. 19 Texas pulled out a wild victory over No. 7 Ole Miss after blowing a 21-point lead in the second half.

items.headline: Arch Manning and No. 19 Texas hang on to beat No. 7 Ole Miss 34-27 after blowing 21-point lead
items.description: — Arch Manning threw a touchdown pass and had his first two rushing scores of the season, including the tiebreaker in the fourth quarter, and No. 19 Texas held on for a wild 34-27 victory over seventh-ranked Mississippi after blowing a 21-point lead...
